blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) on Sunday reaffirmed the country’s recognition of the “One China” policy, noting that its position remains “consistent, clear, and unchanged.” The policy is in line with the 1975 joint communiqué between the Philippines and China, under which the two countries committed to respect each other’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. Under this longstanding framework, the Philippines recognizes the government of the People’s Republic of China as the sole legal government of China. “The One China Policy does not preclude the Philippines from pursuing economic, cultural and functional cooperation with Taiwan.
